definitions.explanation: The current season, in the sense of a sports season, a fashion season, or a broadcasting season. Used much like {今年|ことし} but tied to a season rather than a calendar year.

examples.japanese: {今季|こんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{流行色|りゅうこうしょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧だ。
examples.english: This season's trend color is green.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{今季|こんき}⟦{二十|にじゅう}→二十：00975_nijuu⟧{本|ほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホームラン→ホームラン：20814_hoomuran⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}った→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
examples.english: He has hit twenty home runs this season.

examples.japanese: {今季|こんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{恋愛|れんあい}→恋愛：12634_renai⟧もの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are a lot of romance dramas this season.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{今季|こんき}⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The team announced that it will change managers at the end of this season.

notes:
{今季|こんき} is common in sports reporting, fashion, and TV listings. In everyday talk about the weather or the time of year, people say ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧ or name the season instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {今季|こんき}⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧: through the end of this season (retirement, contracts)
- {今季|こんき}{初|はつ}: the first of this season ({今季|こんき}{初勝利|はつしょうり}, first win of the season)
- {今季|こんき}⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧: the season's best
- {今季|こんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧: this season's new items

RELATED WORDS:
- {来季|らいき}: next season
- {昨季|さっき}: last season
- ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧: this year
